onboarding.title1:
Christian Culture v{{version}}
Your Spiritual Center
onboarding.desc1: Welcome to 2026. The new version is the fruit of combining the most powerful artificial intelligence with the eternal Word of God. We have prepared a space for you for sanctification in the highest quality.
onboarding.desc2: Your prayers, goals, and notes are now secure. Thanks to constant integration with Google Drive, your data is synchronized across all devices and will not disappear after refreshing the application.
onboarding.desc3: Our calendar restores biblical order: Sunday is always the first day of the week. Plan your time from morning on the first day, giving the Lord the firstfruits of your week.
onboarding.desc4: Connect your own Google AI key in settings to unlock 1K/2K graphics generation, full sanctification analysis, and unlimited conversations with Miriam AI.
onboarding.desc5: Every day at 18:00, the system will notify you about the premiere on YouTube. You can join immediately or snooze the reminder for 15, 30, or 60 minutes.
onboarding.desc6: The application can automatically select the language and regional radio station based on your location. Just one button for CC Radio to adapt to your place in the world.
onboarding.title7: Ready to Grow with the Lord?
onboarding.desc7:
All these tools serve one purpose: your sanctification and drawing closer to Christ. May 2026 be a time of your greatest breakthrough.
Glory to God! ✨

cloud.title: Christian Cloud & Sync
cloud.cloudHint: All your data (prayers, goals, notes) is stored locally in your browser. Google Cloud synchronization is optional and enhances data security.

legal.title: Privacy & Compliance
legal.intro: Your privacy is sacred to us. CC Lite is designed so that you have full power over your spiritual data.
legal.dataStorageText: Christian Culture Lite 2026 is a Client-Side application. This means your prayers, goals, notes, and profile data are stored exclusively in your browser's LocalStorage. We, as creators, have no access to them.
legal.cloudIntegrationText: If you choose to connect Google Drive or Calendar, the app will send your data directly to your private cloud. The connection is made through the official Google API and requires your explicit consent at each login.
legal.aiText: The app uses Google Gemini AI services. Verse content, analysis, and conversations are generated in the Google cloud. If you use your own API key, your limits and privacy are subject to Google Cloud Platform terms.
legal.geolocationText: Location access is optional and used solely for automatic language selection and regional radio station picking in Smart Mode. Your coordinates are not saved on external servers.
